class.name: InterDVDProject
class.brief_description: Authoring graph for a VIDEO_TS / AUDIO_TS disc.
class.description: Describes VMG, titles, menus, region mask, and parental level. Export writes an unencrypted DVD-Video volume for burning. Point [code]blazium/inter_dvd/project[/code] at this resource.

method.name: add_title_from_video
method.description: Creates a title PGC with one cell whose [member InterDVDCell.source_path] is [param path], appends it to [member titles], and returns the title.

method.name: language_be16
method.description: Packs an ISO 639-1 code into the 16-bit IFO language field ([code]en[/code] is [code]0x656E[/code]).

method.name: sanitize_volume_id
method.description: Uppercase ISO9660 volume label: [code]A-Z0-9_[/code], max 32 characters. Empty input becomes [code]BLAZIUM_DVD[/code].

method.name: seed_from_project_settings
method.description: Copies [code]blazium/inter_dvd[/code] ProjectSettings defaults onto this resource (region, parental, AC3, GOP, title-safe, warmup).

members.member: AC3 encode bitrate in kbps. Seeded from [code]blazium/inter_dvd/ac3_bitrate_k[/code].
Default ISO 639-1 code for title audio attributes.
Viewport frames skipped before the first captured bake frame.
MPEG GOP size passed to ffmpeg [code]-g[/code].
ISO 639-1 code written on VMGM/VTSM PGCI_UT language units.

[constant InterDVDMenu.MENU_TITLE] menus are concatenated into [code]VIDEO_TS.VOB[/code] (VMGM). Root, audio, subpicture, angle, and chapter menus are concatenated into [code]VTS_01_0.VOB[/code] (VTSM).
Region mask written into the VMG.
Optional disc serial string (max 15 characters) stored with TXTDT.
Default ISO 639-1 code for subtitle attributes when SPU PES is muxed.
NTSC title-safe bottom scanline for HLI clamp (buttons below this are lifted).
Title PGCs (one VTS). Every cell on each title is muxed; use [method add_title_from_video] to add a clip.
ISO9660 volume label passed to mkisofs [code]-V[/code] or oscdimg [code]-l[/code].
